Because O is the incenter, AO and BO bisect these angles, so ∠OAB=A/2 and ∠OBA=B/2. Thus ∠AOB=180°−(A+B)/2=90°. Therefore triangle AOB is right at O with legs OA=5 and OB=12, so AB=sqrt(5^2+12^2)=13.
